title: This Fish Walks on Land Using Crutches, and Nothing Else Does

scenes.text: This fish walks on land using crutches.
It's a mudskipper, and it swings both front fins forward at once.
Scientists call it crutching, and no other living amphibious fish does it.
A 2024 scan found its fin muscles and shoulder are bigger than other fish.
It even has a joint from shoulder to belly fin that no other scanned fish has.
Some fin bones match fossil fish that were ancestors of land animals.

description:
This fish walks on land using crutches.
Mudskippers swing both pectoral fins forward together, a move called crutching that has not been seen in any other living amphibious fish. A 2024 Journal of Anatomy study found unusually large fin muscles and a unique joint.
Would you walk on fins? Comment below.
